name: Kóka (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow horizontal stripes of red and green through the centre, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kóka: a blue shield with a patriarchal cross, with a helm, a lion crest and red and grey mantling, above a scroll inscribed KÓKA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kóka arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
